body:
Hi [First name],

I noticed [their work] and thought VedicHour may fit clients who ask for reflective timing context around ceremonies or introductions.

We do not promise outcomes or certainty. We offer plain-English timing awareness, rating all 18 planetary hours with Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa.

For partners, we can provide a free Pro account, a custom audience discount code like PARTNERNAME10, and a simple revenue share on referred paid reports.

Open to a short conversation?

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

To unsubscribe, reply “unsubscribe.” [Physical address]
linter_reason: Explicitly states no outcome promises, focuses on awareness.
